title: Apalache for inductive invariants
objective: Stamp an inductive-invariant check at fixed constants and a parametric proof of the step, judge what each covers, and decide inductive, counterexample to induction or reachable.

blocks.md:
An inductive invariant satisfies Init ⇒ Inv and Inv ∧ Next ⇒ Inv′. The second is checked from every state the type invariant allows, reachable or not (Lamport's technique; D-05).

TLC enumerates those states for fixed constants. Apalache encodes the check for an SMT solver but still instantiates the constants and types it is given. Either result earns MODEL-CHECKED [M], with the constants and the words "inductive at N = k", never PROVED alone.

Discharge the step with the parameter as an uninterpreted sort in Z3, or prove it in Lean, and the result is PROVED [P] of the encoding, uncertified, with a premise witness and the open defeater "encoding unverified" for the SMT translation of the spec {{run:RUN-z3-inductive-param}}. TLC's check at one fixed N sits beside it {{run:RUN-tlc-inductive}}.

segments.title: Running Apalache, and a gap to spot

blocks.md:
Apalache is optional, on the Bench. Its version is recorded with a bounded smoke check that says nothing more {{run:RUN-apalache-version}}.

A gap to spot: "TLC inductive check at N = 3, stamped PROVED for all N" is a bounded result presented as proof.

RUN-apalache-version.title: Apalache 0.62.4: its version and a bounded smoke check

values.java: OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-21.0.12.1+1 (build 21.0.12.1+1-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)

notes: Apalache 0.62.4 is optional and used only by S5.L9 and drawer D-18 (spine section 9.2). Its inductive-invariant check is bounded by the constants and types it instantiates, so it earns [M], never [P] alone (D-18); the smoke check here is a bounded check of five steps and says nothing more.
binary_sha256 is the SHA-256 of lib/apalache.jar inside the release archive; the archive itself is the input, pinned by the SHA-256 that the release lists in its sha256sum.txt.
The archive unpacks to bin/apalache-mc (a bash launcher), lib/apalache.jar (one fat jar) and LICENSE; it runs unchanged on Eclipse Temurin 21 with the network off.
The smoke log carries a clock time on every line, so a re-run is compared on verdict_lines only.
